units.source_text: 喝这么一丁点酒本来是不会醉的，可能因为在外面走了一阵子，着了凉的缘故，他突然觉着有点恶心，酒劲冲上了脑门。

en.t: He would not normally have become drunk on such a tiny amount of sake, but perhaps because he had been walking outside and caught a chill, he suddenly felt nauseated and the alcohol rushed to his head.

units.source_text: 他觉得脸色苍白，于是闭上眼睛，躺了下来。

en.t: He felt as if his face had gone pale, so he closed his eyes and lay down.
Komako hurried to look after him.

units.source_text: 良久，他对女人那热呼呼的身体，也就完全没有顾忌了。

en.t: Before long, he had lost all reserve toward the woman's warm body.
